_comment: Curated allowlist used to classify a scraped listing as Indian (English/Hindi) stand-up. Matching is case-insensitive substring against the event title and the artist field. Anything that matches keywords but no known artist goes to review_queue rather than being silently included or dropped.
notes: Russell Peters, Zarna Garg, Hasan Minhaj and Akaash Singh are diaspora acts performing in English. They compete for the same audience, so they count as direct competition even though they are not Indian nationals.
Abbas Bukhari performs in Urdu and Munawar Faruqui in Hindi; both draw the same crowd and count as direct.
The seed list came from the Aug 2026 Platinumlist sweep plus well known touring acts likely to appear. Extend it when the review queue surfaces a new name.
